Results.ReviewText: So, we bought this grill for camping trips in our little 19’ camper. We also purchased the portable cart to go with it. We just used it five out of six nights  on a camping trip last week. First, grill performance is standard top notch Weber. Best grilling at the campsite ever for us—filet mignon, seared tuna steaks, pork chops, NY strips, and shrimp tacos. Everything turned out wonderfully. Very steady temperature hold. It is a small grill so you can’t open the lid for very long without losing substantial heat so plan your cooking accordingly. The grill grates are conveniently the perfect size to soak in a standard small camper sink—I don’t know if this was intended, but it’s a wonderful feature that makes cleanup easy. The cart works well as a stand but leaving the grill attached to it for storage is very unwieldy. I recommend separating them for transport. Also, don’t forget to remove the propane bottle for transport. The on/off dial doesn’t lock in the off position so a rough road will turn on the dial and run out your propane. Also, the folding side shelves are a nice feature but I forgot twice to fold them out before lighting the grill. Both times I flipped them out before causing any damage but I have to imagine one day my absent-mindedness might result in two melted shelves. I need to fashion a warning sign for myself. Anyway, so far I love this little grill. The best part is that there is definitely a difference in how tasty the food is on a Weber grill. The styling is a nice bonus—it’s a cool looking little grill.
Results.Title: Very pleased

Even if you keep the grill lid closed and hit it up to 500 degrees. Once you put the food on them they cool down fairly quickly. I am not sure if this is due to the new design of the grills or if the burner is under sized. For now this will have to due since I am not looking to spend more money on another grill, however, just be cautious when purchasing your next grill. Next think I think I will move to a larger version or go full charcoal instead.
